brand.name: NextMoe
brand.tagline: The de facto standard for next-generation ACGN
brand.slogan: NextMoe is the de facto standard for the next generation of anime, manga, games and light novels

hero.lead: NextMoe is a multi-product ACGN community platform: one shared set of account, content and community capabilities behind the independently run sites below.
hero.body: The platform itself is still under active development and has no public product yet. What is live today is the NextMoe account — the sites below already use it to sign people in.

status.title: We are still building
status.body: Rather than list features that do not exist yet, here is the state of things: NextMoe as a platform is still being built, and this site is currently a portal for brand and legal information. If you are looking for content, go straight to the member sites below — those are running today.

portal.name: Brand portal
portal.note: The site you are reading: brand information, privacy policy and terms of service.

account.name: NextMoe account
account.note: account.nextmoe.com — single sign-on and authorization for the member sites.

platform.name: Content platform
platform.note: Cross-media entries, catalogue and community capabilities are still in development, with no public release date.

sites.title: Sites you can use today
sites.body: These sites are run independently and have their own brands and communities; they share the NextMoe account for signing in.

kungal.name: Kun Visual Novel Forum
kungal.desc: A community forum for Galgames and visual novels — discussion, guides and fellow enthusiasts.

moyu.name: Kun Visual Novel Patch
moyu.desc: An open-source, free, no-barrier download site for Galgame patches and resources.

letmoe.name: LetMoe
letmoe.desc: A free, no-barrier ACG game resource site and community — doujin games first, Galgames alongside.

account.title: One account across the member sites
account.body: The NextMoe account is a sign-in and authorization service operated by NextMoe at account.nextmoe.com. Member sites use it over OAuth: a site only receives what the consent screen showed you.

sso.name: Single sign-on
sso.note: Register once and sign in to every member site.

federation.name: Third-party sign-in
federation.note: Sign in with Google or GitHub — we never receive your password.

consent.name: Visible consent
consent.note: Every authorization spells out what the site will receive.

privacy.name: Clear data boundaries
privacy.note: We do not sell your personal data and do not use it for advertising.

account.bloomAlt: Koi, the NextMoe mascot, lying among flowers

footer.about: NextMoe is the de facto standard for the next generation of anime, manga, games and light novels. The platform is still being built.
footer.contactNote: For questions about accounts, privacy or data deletion, email us.
footer.notice: Each member site is run by its own team; their brands and content are independent.

home.title: NextMoe — the de facto standard for next-generation ACGN
home.description: NextMoe is the de facto standard for the next generation of anime, manga, games and light novels: a multi-product ACGN community platform. The platform is still being built; the NextMoe account already signs people in to kungal.com, moyu.moe and letmoe.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — NextMoe
privacy.description: Privacy policy for the NextMoe account service (account.nextmoe.com): what we collect, how third-party sign-in data is used, what is shared with member sites, and how to delete your account.

terms.description: Terms of service for the NextMoe account service and brand portal: what the service is, acceptable use, account responsibility, disclaimers and how to reach us.
